reason: Fails visual garment partition quality despite passing weak relative metrics.

verified_findings.finding: The original head is frozen. The differentiable loss trains individual correction masks, presence and matched IoU; it does not directly supervise the final score-ordered partition. Rejected corrections leave baseline cuts unchanged. Accepted masks can also leave baseline fragments.
Teacher regions 7–10 are prompt=bag, score 0.30–0.53, on visible jacket pockets; whole garment targets are carved into component regions.

The requested region 5, score 0.1801, groups the neckline and disconnected pixels at the blazer/skirt boundary. The neckline component has 159 of 333 region pixels. Region 6, jewellery score 0.1277, covers face/neck pixels.
Teacher shoe proposals 4–6 have scores 0.105–0.110 and lie at wrists and neckline, not shoes.
The hard recall gate needs only +0.05 over a baseline of zero. Passing it can leave 95 percent of the hard cohort unrecovered. It is not a SAM3-parity gate.
62.2 percent of predicted internal edge pixels in white-tank image and 75.7 percent in GR10K are inside an eroded single teacher region. Improved focus-region IoU did not fix the full partition.

unresolved_requirements: Correct automatic supervision at visually distinct garment-piece level
Train final whole-image partition rather than preserve erroneous baseline labels
Evaluate complete garment masks including internal cuts and coverage
Meet latency target after correct batch-one inference
scope: CPU inspection of existing artifacts; no new training or model-quality improvement claimed.
